sections.text:
Type G 
 Cuno Auto Klean Filter is of all metal construction operating on the principle 
 of edge filtration, it is suitable for flows up to eight gallons per minute & 
 will remove all solids larger in dimension than the thickness of specified 
 spacing. Type G 
 Cuno Auto Klean filter is used to filter the low pressure power oil to feed 
 the temperature control valve.

This 
 document initiated by eng: Magdi Sami Ebrahim, accepted by eng: Mohamed Elsayed Ahmed, 
 and approved by eng: Mohamed Salah Eldin Abd Elghafar: general manager of Wady 
 Hof PS.

This document 
 revised by eng. Nageh Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and 
 certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's 
 Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.

Filter 
 element is cleaned without interruption of service, by one complete turn of 
 the filter element.

The 
 positive combing action of the cleaner blades frees it of all solids collected 
 on the filtering surface.

Each 
 filter is equipped with a vent as standard, a built in relief valve arranged 
 to bypass the filter cartage, should a predetermined pressure drop across the 
 cartridge be exceeded maybe substituted for the vent, where a relief valve is 
 required the differential relieving pressure must be specified.
